title: %makearray_dynamic at an unboxed product does not test the length for overflow
summary: `%makearray_dynamic` at an unboxed product does not test the length times the number of components for overflow. With four `int64#` components and length `min_int + 1` it returns an array of length 1; other lengths give an array of length 0 or a segmentation fault. Bytecode raises `Invalid_argument`.
cause: `runtime/array.c`: `size = non_unarized_length * num_components` (and `* num_initializers`) is computed before the test against `Max_array_wosize`, so a product that wraps passes the test.

fix.text: Tests the length against `Max_array_wosize` divided by the number of components before the multiplication, in both functions. Builds; `test.ml` then prints the expected result; testsuite unchanged.
